title: State-Dependent Lyapunov Analysis of Rank-1 Matrix Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2604.26993v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a state-dependent Lyapunov framework for gradient descent on rank-1 matrix factorization. A parameterized quadratic certificate $I(\delta;\,\cdot)$ generates strictly nested sublevel sets. Their ordering assigns each point a state $\delta$, while a boundary-inward property makes this state monotone along gradient-descent trajectories. Together with internal chain transitivity, this geometry identifies the limiting dynamics even when all relevant stationary points are unstable. For scalar and rank-1 factorization, it yields convergence to a global minimizer below the stability threshold and to a balanced period-$2$ orbit in a post-critical interval, for almost every initialization in an explicit region.   We formalize the mechanism through structural and dynamical axioms. Within the origin-centered, exchange-symmetric quadratic class, the axioms determine the ordered level-set geometry uniquely up to a monotone relabe

translated_title: 秩一矩阵分解的状态依赖李雅普诺夫分析
translated_abstract: 我们为秩一矩阵分解上的梯度下降开发了一个状态依赖的李雅普诺夫框架。一个参数化的二次证书 I(δ; ·) 生成严格嵌套的下水平集，其排序为每个点分配一个状态 δ，而边界内向性质使该状态沿梯度下降轨迹保持单调。结合内部链传递性，这一几何结构即使在所有相关驻点均不稳定的情况下也能识别极限动力学。对于标量和秩一分解，该框架证明：在显式区域中对几乎所有初始化，当参数低于稳定性阈值时梯度下降收敛到全局极小值点，而在临界后区间内则收敛到平衡的周期2轨道。我们通过结构公理和动力学公理将这一机制形式化。在以原点为中心、具有交换对称性的二次类中，这些公理在单调重标记的意义下唯一确定了有序水平集几何。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于参数化二次证书嵌套下水平集的状态依赖李雅普诺夫分析框架，证明了秩一矩阵分解中梯度下降即使在所有相关驻点均不稳定时，也能在显式区域内对几乎所有初始化收敛到全局极小值点或平衡的周期2轨道。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a state-dependent Lyapunov framework based on nested sublevel sets of a parameterized quadratic certificate, proving that gradient descent on rank-1 matrix factorization converges to a global minimizer or a balanced period-2 orbit for almost every initialization, even when all relevant stationary points are unstable.
